entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XVII
The reduced rate only applies to:
- pieces of bone conditioned to be implanted in the human body in order to totally or partially replace parts of the skeletons: 3001 9020, 3001 9098

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Supply of prostheses and their accessories, with the exception of dental prostheses exempt from tax under art.292 para.(1) lett.(b) and supply of orthopedic products. When those goods are imported from a third territory or a third country, the reduced VAT rate is conditioned by submission of the Customs Notice for medical devices or the Declaration of conformity of the medical device manufacturer according to art.12 of the Order no.1009/2016. Art.294 para.(5) letters c), d) of the Fiscal Code.
